description: This file defines structures, enums, and functions for wake word detection, including segment representation, configuration, matching logic, and optional speech transcription integration.

classes.name: WakeWordSegment
classes.description: Represents an audio segment with text, start time, duration, and optional range.

classes.name: WakeWordGateConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for wake word detection, including triggers and timing constraints.

classes.name: WakeWordGateMatch
classes.description: Result of a wake word match, including trigger end time, post-gap, and command text.

classes.name: WakeWordGate
classes.description: Contains static methods to perform wake word detection and related processing.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Performs wake word detection by matching trigger words within segments based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: commandText
methods.description: Constructs the command text following the wake word trigger from transcript and segments.

methods.name: matchesTextOnly
methods.description: Checks if a given text contains any trigger words in a case-insensitive manner.

methods.name: from(transcription:transcript:)
methods.description: Converts SFTranscription segments into WakeWordSegment objects (when Speech framework is available).
